commands.name: addOp
commands.summary: Add a child operator by symbol GUID or exact case-insensitive name.

arguments.name: compositionId
arguments.description: Address a loaded composition symbol, not an instance path.

arguments.name: symbolId
arguments.description: A parseable ID takes precedence. Unknown GUID currently can report success without adding a child.

arguments.name: symbolName
arguments.description: Exact case-insensitive search across loaded packages. Ambiguous names report candidates.

arguments.name: posX
arguments.description: Canvas X coordinate.
arguments.omissionBehavior: With neither coordinate, place on a free row; otherwise missing X is 0.

arguments.name: posY
arguments.description: Canvas Y coordinate.
arguments.omissionBehavior: With neither coordinate, place on a free row; otherwise missing Y is 0.

commands.result: Object with childId and symbolId. Verify graph postcondition for unknown GUIDs.
commands.effects: Undoable graph mutation; may instantiate an operator with device/asset costs and autosave changes.
commands.completion: Immediate, including operator creation cost.

commands.name: cancelRender
commands.summary: Cancel an active export, or report the current status message when idle.
commands.result: Object {message:string}. An idle request leaves the existing message; there is no cancelled flag.
commands.effects: Stops an active export and cleans up its session; partial output may remain. Does not delete artifacts or restore arbitrary caller state.
commands.completion: Cancellation is requested synchronously; inspect status and artifact state after subsequent frames.

commands.name: connect
commands.summary: Connect a source child output to a target child input.

arguments.name: compositionId
arguments.description: Address a loaded composition symbol, not an instance path.

arguments.name: sourceChildId
arguments.description: Existing source child in composition.

arguments.name: targetChildId
arguments.description: Existing target child in composition.

arguments.name: sourceOutput
arguments.description: Case-insensitive output name or GUID.

arguments.name: targetInput
arguments.description: Case-insensitive input name or GUID.

arguments.name: multiInputIndex
arguments.description: Connection insertion index; validity depends on target input and existing connections.

commands.result: Empty result object.
commands.effects: Undoable connection mutation. Cycle rejection is applied only when the addressed symbol is the focused composition; do not infer global cycle protection.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: deleteOp
commands.summary: Delete one child and its graph connections.

arguments.name: compositionId
arguments.description: Address a loaded composition symbol, not an instance path.

arguments.name: childId
arguments.description: Child instance ID within the addressed composition.

commands.result: Empty result object.
commands.effects: Undoable graph deletion; autosave may persist it.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: deleteSelection
commands.summary: Delete the focused graph's selected nodes.

arguments.name: disconnect
arguments.description: True removes connections without trying to retain the flow.

commands.result: Object with deleted boolean and selectedIds for remaining selection.
commands.effects: Undoable graph mutation through the existing graph view. Empty selection can be a no-op.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: focusGraphView
commands.summary: Frame specified children, the selection, or the whole graph.

arguments.name: childIds
arguments.description: Explicit children take precedence over all. Missing-symbol stand-ins explicitly named here are included regardless of includeMissing. Invalid GUID gives INVALID_PARAM; absent child gives NOT_FOUND.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Use selection; if empty, all graph children.

arguments.name: all
arguments.description: Without childIds, clears selection before computing bounds. Ignored when childIds is an array.

arguments.name: includeMissing
arguments.description: Add all missing-symbol stand-in bounds.

arguments.name: padding
arguments.description: Expand bounds by canvas units. Negative values are not explicitly rejected.

arguments.name: smooth
arguments.description: Choose smooth rather than instant fitting.

commands.result: Object {appliesNextFrame:true,area:{minX,minY,maxX,maxY}} describes requested bounds including padding.
commands.effects: Queues canvas fitting; all:true can clear selection even if there is nothing to focus.
commands.completion: Fit is applied on a later canvas frame; pump and read getGraphView to inspect its result.

commands.name: getAudioInputs
commands.summary: List available input devices and current capture analysis state.
commands.result: Object {devices:[{name:string,isLoopback:boolean}],active:string|null,level:number}. No recording-path or recording-status field is returned.
commands.effects: Enumerates input devices lazily on first request. Does not start capture. Enumeration can be empty if the native engine is unavailable.
commands.completion: Immediate snapshot; level is the decaying input level and active is the current capture device, not proof of a recording.

commands.name: getContext
commands.summary: Inspect focused composition, selection, time, and primary output view.
commands.result: Always hasOpenProject boolean and time object (timeInBars,timeInSecs,playbackSpeed,isPlaying,bpm). With a focused composition: compositionSymbolId,compositionName,compositionPath string array,selectedChildren [{childId,name}]. Optional outputView contains isPinned and, if resolvable, childId,symbolName,path.
commands.effects: Read only, apart from shared agent-ready handoff. Child IDs are composition-scoped.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: getFrameSamples
commands.summary: Read the performance window's ordered timing samples.
commands.result: Object with totalFrames integer and frameMs,cpuMs,presentMs numeric arrays, each oldest first. Series are recorded independently and may have different lengths during warmup; do not zip them as synchronized samples. Durations are rounded to two decimal places.
commands.effects: Allocates arrays and response JSON on explicit request; avoid polling for idle profiling.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: getGraphState
commands.summary: Inspect a known symbol graph or the focused composition.

arguments.name: compositionId
arguments.description: Address a loaded composition symbol, not an instance path.

arguments.name: includeDefaults
arguments.description: Include unchanged child inputs as well as overridden values.

commands.result: Object with symbolId,symbolName,children and connections. Each child has childId,symbolId,symbolName, optional custom name, true-only isBypassed/isDisabled, optional posX/posY, and inputs [{id,name,isDefault,value}]. Unserializable inputs use {unserializable:typeName}. Connections have sourceParentOrChildId,sourceSlotId,targetParentOrChildId,targetSlotId. Optional missingChildren/missingConnections preserve unresolved references; missing connections include multiInputIndex. Does not return complete output slot schemas or list the operator library.
commands.effects: Reads symbol definitions/current stored inputs; values can differ from evaluated connected inputs. Explicit query allocates JSON.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: getGraphView
commands.summary: Read the focused graph canvas's target scope.
commands.result: Object with scale,scrollX,scrollY,visibleArea:{minX,minY,maxX,maxY},windowX,windowY,windowWidth,windowHeight. Describes target scope, not necessarily the currently drawn interpolated scope.
commands.effects: Reads existing canvas; does not create a view.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: getLogTail
commands.summary: Read buffered log entries with sequence cursors.

arguments.name: sinceSeq
arguments.description: Return entries with seq greater than this cursor. Negative means newest window; stale cursor starts at oldest retained entry.

arguments.name: maxCount
arguments.description: Maximum entries. Nonpositive returns no entries. Buffer retains 4096 records; newest-window selection occurs before level filtering.

arguments.name: minLevel
arguments.description: Case-insensitive debug/info/warning/warn/error; unknown strings fall back to debug.

commands.result: Object with entries array, latestSeq, oldestAvailableSeq. Entry fields: seq integer, time HH:mm:ss.fff, level string, message string, sourceId GUID string or null. Old records can roll out.
commands.effects: Allocates response from in-memory ring buffer. Does not clear logs.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: getMetrics
commands.summary: Read timing, memory, render statistics, and resource counters.
commands.result: Numeric fields frameDeltaSeconds,fps,framePeriodMs,refreshRateHz,visualDeltaMs,vblanksPerFrame,frameSpeedFactor,gpuFrameMs,queuedFrames,gcTotalMemoryMb,stateStackDepth,liveGpuResources; presentationMode string; renderStats object. gpuMemory is null when unavailable, otherwise currentUsageMb,budgetMb and optionally resourceMb.
commands.effects: Queries backend/DXGI memory and allocates a result; repeated calls are not a zero-cost idle measurement.
commands.completion: Immediate; device queries can incur work.

commands.name: getOutput
commands.summary: Inspect a focused child output or the project root, optionally forcing evaluation.

arguments.name: childId
arguments.description: Valid GUID resolves a child of the focused composition. Unparseable text follows the root path, like omission.

arguments.name: outputId
arguments.description: A parseable ID takes precedence; unresolved valid ID does not fall back.

arguments.name: outputName
arguments.description: Case-insensitive name if outputId is absent or unparseable.

arguments.name: update
arguments.description: Force invalidation and evaluation when true.

arguments.name: dumpObj
arguments.description: For nonempty mesh output, attempt OBJ file export. Only meaningful for geometry.

arguments.name: readCount
arguments.description: Optional CPU list or GPU buffer element count; nonpositive omits elements.

arguments.name: readOffset
arguments.description: Element offset clamped to >=0. Count is limited by remaining elements.

commands.result: Object with outputId,valueType,value. Scalars float/double/int/bool/string return scalar JSON; Vector2/3/4 return arrays. Unsupported types (including Matrix4x4 and List<int>) and missing resources return null; valueType alone does not prove value availability. Texture summary: width,height,format,mipLevels,arraySize,bindFlags,optionFlags,disposed. Geometry summary: pointCount,faceCount,cornerCount,partCount,boundsMin,boundsMax,boundaryEdges,boundaryEdgesOnCuts,boundaryEdgeSamples,nonManifoldEdges,volume,attributes. Buffer summary: sizeInBytes,stride,elementCount,disposed. Structured-list summary: type,elementCount,elementSizeInBytes. Positive buffer/list readCount adds elements when storage is available; offsets clamp to zero and out-of-range offsets produce an empty array. A 64-byte stride is interpreted as Point fields (index,position,f1,orientation,color,scale,f2), other strides as float arrays regardless of actual element type. Integer buffer bytes are reinterpreted, not numerically converted. Geometry OBJ export preserves polygon corners and writes synchronously; file errors become INTERNAL_ERROR.
commands.effects: update can evaluate CPU/GPU code and may double-evaluate a viewed operator. GPU reads synchronously wait for readback; CPU list reads serialize the full list before slicing. dumpObj writes files. No compositionId parameter.
commands.completion: Immediate except synchronous evaluation/readback/export cost.

commands.name: getPaths
commands.summary: Report the running editor's actual profile and project paths.
commands.result: Object with absolute settings, temp, cache, projects paths; log is nullable if no log writer exists. Projects is the default project root, not a list of loaded projects.
commands.effects: Read only, apart from shared agent-ready handoff.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: getRenderStatus
commands.summary: Read current export state and progress.
commands.result: Object {state:string,isExporting:boolean,progress:number,frameIndex:integer,message:string}. Current state names: Undefined, NoOutputWindow, NoValidOutputType, NoValidOutputTexture, ReadyForExport, Exporting. frameIndex belongs to the active session and becomes zero after cleanup; progress can reset to zero. Existing continuous exports can report negative progress. message is human-readable status, not a structured success code.
commands.effects: Read-only snapshot of the existing render process.
commands.completion: Immediate; isExporting:false alone does not distinguish success, cancellation, unavailable output or late failure.

commands.name: getShaderErrors
commands.summary: Read shader compilation failures or clear them.

arguments.name: clear
arguments.description: When true, clears the failure list and returns immediately, ignoring includeSource.

arguments.name: includeSource
arguments.description: Attempt to read each available sourcePath file. Adds source text or sourceError per entry; missing sourcePath adds neither.

commands.result: Clear variant: {cleared:true}. Read variant: {count,failures:[{time,name,entryPoint,reason,ownerPath,ownerId,sourcePath,sourceLineCount,source?,sourceError?}]}; newest first.
commands.effects: clear mutates recorded failures. includeSource reads files and can enlarge the response.
commands.completion: Immediate; source reads happen on the main thread.

commands.name: getStructureVersion
commands.summary: Read the symbol-structure counter.
commands.result: Object with symbolStructureVersion integer. This differs from the envelope's structureVersion UI counter and is not an exact package/build identity.
commands.effects: Read only, apart from shared agent-ready handoff.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: getVersion
commands.summary: Report assembly version and bridge protocol version.
commands.result: Object with protocolVersion (integer, currently 1) and editorVersion (assembly version string, nullable). Assembly version is not exact commit identity.
commands.effects: Read only, apart from the shared agent-ready handoff rule.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: layoutSelection
commands.summary: Arrange inputs of the current graph selection.
commands.result: Object {changed:boolean,selectedIds:GUID string array}. changed means something moved or selection grew; false can mean empty selection, no applicable work or active interaction.
commands.effects: Moves graph nodes through existing undoable layout commands and can expand selection upstream. Connections are preserved; saved layout can change.
commands.completion: Immediate operation using the cached graph UI layout. Known current limitation: bridge add/connect can leave this cache stale even after frames; layout then reports changed:false. A validated undo/redo of the last graph edit rebuilds the view, after which layout works. Do not silently replay arbitrary edits as a general refresh strategy.

commands.name: newProject
commands.summary: Create and compile an editable project in the configured project root.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Namespace; its final dot-separated component becomes the project name. Use a unique name and an owned root for automation.

commands.result: Object {displayName:string,homeSymbolId:GUID string}. Does not itself open the project.
commands.effects: Writes project files and compiles/loads its package; failures can leave files. Names are passed to existing project setup; this endpoint is not a sandbox.
commands.completion: Synchronous; compilation blocks the main thread. A timeout does not cancel creation.

commands.name: openProject
commands.summary: Open a loaded package by display name or explicit home symbol.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Case-insensitive package display name or short prefix before ' ('. First matching package wins.

arguments.name: symbolId
arguments.description: Takes precedence over name whenever present; malformed text fails rather than falling back. May address a loaded symbol as explicit home.

arguments.name: pinOutput
arguments.description: Pin the root when a primary output window exists; false does not clear an existing pin.

commands.result: Object {rootSymbolId:GUID string|null,rootSymbolName:string|null,pinnedOutput:boolean}. pinnedOutput describes this call, not whether any output was already pinned.
commands.effects: Creates project view state, resolves package instances and may pin output; opening can load resources and evaluate operators.
commands.completion: Immediate after view assignment; later rendering continues.

commands.name: openWindow
commands.summary: Show an existing window by its type name.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Case-insensitive type name of an existing WindowManager window; does not create a new instance.

arguments.name: section
arguments.description: SettingsWindow category, case-insensitive: Interface, Theme, Projects, Audio, Midi, InputDevices, Keyboard, Diagnostics. Other windows ignore it. Current Enum.TryParse also accepts numeric strings; no defined-value validation is promised.

commands.result: Object {window:string} with the actual type name.
commands.effects: Sets window visibility before checking settings category. INVALID_PARAM can therefore still make the window visible. Window layout/settings may persist.
commands.completion: Immediate state assignment; drawing occurs on a frame.

commands.name: outputSetup
commands.summary: Enter output-setup view and optionally choose an entity and edit mode.

arguments.name: entity
arguments.description: Exact case-sensitive entity name, first match in existing setup search order. Does not enumerate entities.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: Case-insensitive edit-mode name: Board, Straight or Output. Current Enum.TryParse also accepts numeric strings; unsupported numeric values have no validated meaning.

commands.result: Empty result object.
commands.effects: Requires an active setup. Sets setup view before validating entity/mode; a failed mode can leave view and entity selection changed.
commands.completion: Immediate state assignment; visible effect follows drawing.

commands.name: pin
commands.summary: Pin an existing focused-composition child in the primary visible output window.

arguments.name: childId
arguments.description: Child must be an instance in the focused composition.

commands.result: Empty result object.
commands.effects: Changes output pinning and may cause operator evaluation/rendering on subsequent frames.
commands.completion: Immediate pin assignment; inspect getContext and allow frames for output.

commands.name: ping
commands.summary: Check bridge responsiveness without changing agent handoff state.
commands.result: Empty result object; standard envelope echoes the request ID and includes frame/playbackFrame/structureVersion.
commands.effects: No command-specific mutation. Reaches the editor frame queue.
commands.completion: Immediate once serviced on the main thread.

commands.name: pumpFrames
commands.summary: Wait for a number of main-thread queue passes.

arguments.name: count
arguments.description: Clamped to 1..100000; this counts UI queue passes, not elapsed seconds or distinct output evaluations.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Defaults to 1; explicit null or invalid conversion throws.

commands.result: Empty object {} with envelope counters from the completion frame.
commands.effects: Registers a pending reply; does not change playback speed or force a particular operator to evaluate.
commands.completion: Deferred. Count decrements at the beginning of later queue passes. Other requests may finish first; responses must be matched by ID. Timeout/disconnect does not cancel queued work.

commands.name: redo
commands.summary: Redo one available history entry.
commands.result: Object with canUndo and canRedo booleans after the operation.
commands.effects: Mutates graph/UI according to the history entry; no-op at history boundary. Scope is the existing undo stack, not a transaction per bridge client.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: releaseGpuResources
commands.summary: Request release of cached GPU resources.
commands.result: Empty result object acknowledges the release request.
commands.effects: Schedules GPU resource release for the start of the next frame; active resources can be recreated. Does not promise all GPU memory becomes zero.
commands.completion: Acknowledgement precedes release. Pump a frame before inspecting effects.

commands.name: reload
commands.summary: Recompile and reload an existing editable project.

arguments.name: project
arguments.description: Case-insensitive display name or short prefix before ' ('; only EditableSymbolProject entries are considered.

commands.result: Object {durationSeconds:number}, rounded to one decimal place. Failure detail contains compiler diagnostics when available.
commands.effects: Saves/rebuilds package state and replaces runtime instances. Built-in compiled packages require restart. Resolve symbols and children by GUID again after reload.
commands.completion: Synchronous main-thread compile; allow a generous bounded client timeout. Timeout is not cancellation.

commands.name: resetView
commands.summary: Reset the primary visible output window's view camera.
commands.result: Empty result object.
commands.effects: Changes existing camera/view state; does not reset graph canvas, pinning or project data.
commands.completion: Immediate reset request; next output frame reflects camera state.

commands.name: screenshot
commands.summary: Save the current output texture or a rendered editor UI frame.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Output file path. Case-insensitive .jpg selects JPEG; all other suffixes, including .jpeg, select PNG. Relative paths are accepted but resolve against the editor working directory; use a fresh full path in an owned folder.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Exact case-sensitive output or ui. UI captures the next back buffer and forces opaque alpha. Output requires a current texture in a visible output window.

commands.result: Object {path:string} echoes the writer's requested path. Known limitation: save/encoding exceptions may be logged but still produce a successful path reply with no usable file. Independently verify the file and decoder result.
commands.effects: GPU readback and image encoding; can overwrite the requested file. Parent folders are not created by ScreenshotWriter. The shared writer's format/alpha state and single pending UI callback make overlapping requests unsafe.
commands.completion: Deferred readback callback. A successful reply alone is not a file-saved guarantee; a timeout leaves an unknown outcome and must not trigger automatic replay.

commands.name: screenshotWindow
commands.summary: Capture the editor window client area using the Windows capture path.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Output path; .jpg selects JPEG, other suffixes PNG. Creates missing parent directories. Relative paths are accepted, but automation should use a full owned path.

arguments.name: region
arguments.description: Exact graph crops to the current graph canvas bounds intersected with the client area. Any other nonempty string is INVALID_PARAM.

commands.result: Object {path:string} with normalized full path on success. The command exists on all targets, but non-Windows capture returns SCREENSHOT_FAILED with an unsupported-platform detail.
commands.effects: Captures the owned OS window, crops and encodes an image; creates parent folders and can overwrite a file. Depends on client-area/window availability.
commands.completion: Synchronous capture and save; errors are returned rather than the screenshot writer's deferred callback.

commands.name: select
commands.summary: Replace, add to, or clear the focused composition's child selection.

arguments.name: childId
arguments.description: One child; an unparseable single ID is ignored.

arguments.name: childIds
arguments.description: Additional IDs; a non-GUID element yields INVALID_PARAM.

arguments.name: add
arguments.description: Append when true; requires at least one parsed ID.

commands.result: Object with selectedCount; optional notFound array lists unresolved child IDs. With no IDs and add=false, clears selection.
commands.effects: Changes UI selection; selection can make an output view evaluate the selected operator.
commands.completion: Immediate selection change; rendering follows.

commands.name: setAgentState
commands.summary: Set the diagnostic agent busy/ready indicator.

arguments.name: state
arguments.description: Exact values busy, ready, or empty string; uppercase variants are invalid.

arguments.name: note
arguments.description: Optional indicator note.

commands.result: Object with state equal to the accepted string.
commands.effects: Changes transient agent indicator and note. Any other command except ping changes ready to busy; there is no separate read-state command.
commands.completion: Immediate.

commands.name: setAudioInput
commands.summary: Choose external input analysis or the project's soundtrack.

arguments.name: device
arguments.description: Nonempty selects ExternalDevice and stores the name without checking that it exists. Empty selects ProjectSoundTrack. No trim or case-insensitive matching.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Missing or null acts as empty string.

commands.result: Object {audioSource:string}, with ExternalDevice or ProjectSoundTrack.
commands.effects: Mutates composition playback settings. A selected real device can start capture in subsequent audio frames. An unknown name can be acknowledged but never become active; inspect state and logs.
commands.completion: Immediate settings acknowledgement; device opening/switching happens afterward. This response does not prove device availability.

commands.name: setBypass
commands.summary: Set bypass on a bypassable child.

arguments.name: compositionId
arguments.description: Address a loaded composition symbol, not an instance path.

arguments.name: childId
arguments.description: Child instance ID within the addressed composition.

arguments.name: bypassed
arguments.description: Requested bypass state.

commands.result: Object {bypassed:boolean} reports stored state. With instantiated children whose main output has no connection, the underlying setter leaves state unchanged even though the request succeeds. Known defect: with connected output but unconnected scalar first input, bypass can alter evaluation before an invalidation exception is caught; reply and graph still report false. Check output and error logs, not just the success flag.
commands.effects: Undoable graph mutation; available only for compatible first input/output types.
commands.completion: Immediate stored state.

commands.name: setFrameLatency
commands.summary: Report or set the number of frames in flight.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: Non-null values clamp to [1,2].
arguments.omissionBehavior: Report only. Explicit JSON null is different: conversion fails with INTERNAL_ERROR.

commands.result: Object with frameLatency integer.
commands.effects: Changes user settings when supplied; normally persisted on exit. Backend determines actual presentation behavior.
commands.completion: Immediate setting update.

commands.name: setGraphView
commands.summary: Set or adjust the focused graph canvas.

arguments.name: area
arguments.description: If an object, takes precedence over all center/scale/relative fields. Missing components are zero; max must exceed min on both axes.

arguments.name: centerX
arguments.description: Absolute canvas center X before relative scrolling.

arguments.name: centerY
arguments.description: Absolute canvas center Y before relative scrolling.

arguments.name: scale
arguments.description: Absolute scale before zoomBy. Resulting scale must be greater than 0.001 and at most 100; NaN is rejected. Center/scroll finiteness has no corresponding explicit check.

arguments.name: zoomBy
arguments.description: Multiply the selected scale.

arguments.name: scrollByX
arguments.description: Add to selected center X in canvas units.

arguments.name: scrollByY
arguments.description: Add to selected center Y in canvas units.

arguments.name: smooth
arguments.description: Use target interpolation rather than an instant scope change.

commands.result: Object with scale,scrollX,scrollY,visibleArea:{minX,minY,maxX,maxY},windowX,windowY,windowWidth,windowHeight. Describes target scope, not necessarily the currently drawn interpolated scope. Area branch instead returns {appliesNextFrame:true}.
commands.effects: Changes graph view only. Area fitting is queued until the canvas knows its current window size.
commands.completion: Area fitting applies on a later frame; non-area response describes the assigned target.

commands.name: setInput
commands.summary: Set a stored child input value through its existing codec.

arguments.name: compositionId
arguments.description: Address a loaded composition symbol, not an instance path.

arguments.name: childId
arguments.description: Child instance ID within the addressed composition.

arguments.name: inputId
arguments.description: A parseable ID takes precedence over inputName even if it does not resolve.

arguments.name: inputName
arguments.description: Case-insensitive name fallback when inputId is absent or unparseable.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: Decoded by the existing input type converter. Explicit null is passed to that converter; omission is distinct. Representative formats include scalar JSON, vectors with named X/Y/Z/W fields, List<int> as {Values:[...]}, and Matrix4x4 as 16 row-major numbers. A malformed matrix shape silently selects identity rather than rejecting the request. There is no universal input JSON shape or universal invalid-value rejection.

commands.result: Object {input:resolvedInputName}.
commands.effects: Undoable graph mutation; autosave may persist it. Connected/driven inputs can evaluate differently from their stored value. Does not itself force graph evaluation.
commands.completion: Immediate stored-value change.

commands.name: setPlayback
commands.summary: Set or report current playback speed.

arguments.name: speed
arguments.description: Takes precedence over playing whenever present. Negative speeds accepted. Handler does not validate finite values or impose bounds.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Use playing if supplied; otherwise retain current speed.

arguments.name: playing
arguments.description: true sets speed 1; false sets speed 0. Ignored when speed exists.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Leave speed unchanged unless speed supplied.

commands.result: Object {playbackSpeed:number}.
commands.effects: Changes Playback.Current speed. getContext reports isPlaying as abs(speed) > 0.001. Explicit null for either selected field throws.
commands.completion: Immediate acknowledgement; timeline advancement is later frame work.

commands.name: setTargetFrameRate
commands.summary: Report or set the target frame-rate preference.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: Non-null values clamp to >=0. Zero renders every refresh.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Report only. Explicit JSON null is different: conversion fails with INTERNAL_ERROR.

commands.result: Object with targetFrameRate integer.
commands.effects: Changes user settings when a value is supplied; normally persisted on exit. Hardware and rendering determine achieved rate.
commands.completion: Immediate setting update.

commands.name: setTime
commands.summary: Set or report current playback time.

arguments.name: timeInBars
arguments.description: Takes precedence over timeInSecs whenever the property exists, including explicit null. Negative values accepted; no finite/range validation in the handler.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Leave time unchanged unless timeInSecs is supplied.

arguments.name: timeInSecs
arguments.description: Converted through current BPM: bars = seconds * BPM / 240. Ignored when timeInBars exists.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Leave time unchanged unless timeInBars is supplied.

commands.result: Object {timeInBars:number,timeInSecs:number}.
commands.effects: Changes Playback.Current time; does not pause playback. Omission of both fields reads current time. Explicit null/nonconvertible values throw.
commands.completion: Immediate acknowledgement; subsequent frames can advance time when playing.

commands.name: setVSync
commands.summary: Report or set the VSync preference.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: When non-null, writes UseVSync.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Report only. Explicit JSON null is different: conversion fails with INTERNAL_ERROR.

commands.result: Object with useVSync boolean.
commands.effects: A supplied non-null value changes user settings, normally persisted on exit; it is a preference, not a guarantee of presentation behavior.
commands.completion: Immediate setting update; rendering applies the preference subsequently.

commands.name: shutdown
commands.summary: Request application exit, discarding unsaved project edits.
commands.result: An empty success result is sent before requesting exit; connection teardown may prevent the caller receiving it.
commands.effects: Exits TiXL. Unsaved edits are discarded; normal exit may persist user settings. Use only an owned session in tests.
commands.completion: Reply may race teardown; verify owned process exit separately.

commands.name: stallMainThread
commands.summary: Intentionally block the editor frame thread.

arguments.name: seconds
arguments.description: Sleep duration clamped to [0,120].

arguments.name: estimateKey
arguments.description: Nonempty value wraps work in MainThreadActivity for estimated-progress UI.

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: Message used by the activity wrapper.

commands.result: Empty result object after sleep.
commands.effects: Blocks rendering and UI; logs a debug entry. Tests use bounded short stalls in fresh owned sessions.
commands.completion: Deferred by synchronous sleep; not cancellable by client timeout.

commands.name: startAudioRecording
commands.summary: Request capture into a temporary PCM WAV recording.
commands.result: Object {path:string|null}. A null path with ok:true means recording did not start, including an already-active session.
commands.effects: May start real input capture, using the configured device or falling back to the first enumerated device when it cannot resolve one. Writes under getPaths.temp/Recordings using existing automatic session naming. Does not take a path or device argument. Device selection is not a sandbox.
commands.completion: Returns once a WAV writer is created, before samples or final header are guaranteed. Use stopAudioRecording and validate the finalized file. Failures are generally logged with a null path; no structured recording status endpoint exists.

commands.name: startRender
commands.summary: Start a video export from the current output texture.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Target path must satisfy platform Path.IsPathRooted. On Windows this is broader than fully qualified; supply a full owned path. Export setup can create the parent directory.

arguments.name: startSecs
arguments.description: Requested start time in seconds. Copied into cloned render settings with seconds as their reference.

arguments.name: durationSecs
arguments.description: Duration in seconds; values <=0 are rejected. The handler has no separate finite-number validation.

arguments.name: fps
arguments.description: Frame rate; no explicit handler range/finite validation. Advertised frameCount rounds duration times fps.

arguments.name: codec
arguments.description: Case-insensitive VideoExportCodec name: H264, ProRes, VP9, AV1, FFV1, Hap, HapAlpha, HapQ, Hevc. An unparseable string leaves the cloned codec unchanged; numeric strings are accepted by Enum.TryParse without defined-value checking.

arguments.name: exportAudio
arguments.description: Whether to include composition audio. Requires corresponding exporter/audio prerequisites.

commands.result: Object {path:string,frameCount:integer} acknowledges accepted settings. It does not establish encoder availability, successful completion or file readability.
commands.effects: Clones render settings, requests video export and advances playback frame-by-frame. Requires a valid Texture2D, visible output and ReadyForExport state. Encoder setup can fail later. An existing target may be overwritten; cancellation may leave a partial file.
commands.completion: Accepted export completes over later frames. Poll getRenderStatus and inspect the actual artifact and logs; do not treat the acknowledgement as completion.

commands.name: stopAudioRecording
commands.summary: Stop an active WAV recording and finalize its header.
commands.result: Object {path:string|null}; null when idle, otherwise the finalized recording path.
commands.effects: Closes the active writer; warns if it captured no samples. Capture may remain active for ExternalDevice analysis; recording-only capture teardown is later frame work.
commands.completion: Synchronous file finalization when active. A readable header alone does not prove that samples were captured.

commands.name: undo
commands.summary: Undo one available history entry.
commands.result: Object with canUndo and canRedo booleans after the operation.
commands.effects: Mutates graph/UI according to the history entry; no-op at history boundary. Scope is the existing undo stack, not a transaction per bridge client.
commands.completion: Immediate.
